## Wave 4 Summary

This wave runs the one genuine adversarial adjudication of investigation-6: a 2-agent workshop on the framework's #1 standing gap, M_KK (the one imported dimensional scale). Three concrete substrate determinations of M_KK are computed elsewhere in this investigation — the gauge-vs-gravity bracket (INV6-W1-1), the Casimir-volume minimum (INV6-W1-2), and the Sakharov-Γ[τ] self-consistency (INV6-W2-1). The two domain advocates read WHICH route is canonical OPPOSITELY: kaluza-klein-theorist (G-KK1 + B-KK1) holds that the KK-native Casimir-volume minimum furnishes the moduli-stabilization scale that fixes M_KK and resolves the 6.79× bracket toward the gravity route; feynman-theorist (G-F3 + B-F3) holds that the §VII.BS rank-1 NNU theorem read honestly is a *precise statement of a gap*, and that the Sakharov-induced-G_N ↔ spectral-zeta self-consistency from the one-loop Γ[τ] over-determines M_KK at the loop level — making the tree-level bracket an artifact. This is the seed's single Q1 math/physics adjudication (`Investigating-Workshops.md §"Q1"`): the readings invoke different machinery (KK Casimir-volume-minimum vs QFT Sakharov-loop), they cannot both be the canonical route, and the workshop's job is to derive a STRUCTURAL VERDICT (which route is substrate-canonical, the convergence status of the three determinations, and what the verdict does to the A_s/CC absolute-magnitude breakages) plus the single decisive forward compute. The wave carries exactly one workshop gate; it closes by artifact-existence (no verdict line).

## Wave 4 Decision Point Prerequisites

INV6-W4-1 is an exploratory adjudication workshop. Its three upstream computes — INV6-W1-1 (`inv6_gate_verdicts.txt`, M-KK-BRACKET-PROPAGATE), INV6-W1-2 (`inv6_gate_verdicts.txt`, KK-CASIMIR-VOLUME), INV6-W2-1 (`inv6_gate_verdicts.txt`, GAMMA-TAU-ONELOOP-TRAJECTORY) — supply the numerical substrate the advocates argue over. The workshop is robust to the prerequisite landings: it adjudicates the determination-route STRUCTURE (which route is canonical / convergence status) and reads the upstream verdict VALUES into that structure when available.

- **All three upstream verdicts landed (PASS/INFO)**: the workshop reads the three determinations (bracket ratio, Casimir-minimum status, Sakharov self-consistency outcome) as live numerical inputs and adjudicates over-vs-under-determination against the actual values.
- **One or more upstream verdicts unlanded at dispatch**: the workshop proceeds on the STRUCTURAL readings (the two advocates' G-KK1/B-KK1 and G-F3/B-F3 positions are self-contained derivational arguments, not numerical dependencies), adjudicates the route-canonicality question on the structural axis, and pins the missing numerical determination(s) as the named content of its decisive forward gate (sub-question (d)). The deliverable lands by artifact-existence regardless; the upstream values, when present, sharpen sub-questions (a)-(c) but are not a hard gate on the workshop's closure (a workshop closes on Wrap-Up + Effected-In-Session + Carry-Forward-Computations content, not on a numerical threshold). Cross-link `mechanical-closure-discipline.md` — an unlanded prereq does NOT block this gate; it routes the unlanded determination into the forward-compute (d).

    frame M_KK as "the size of an extra dimension the fields live in" — it is the one scale the substrate's own
    spectral content imports. The verdict scopes M_KK's confidence (derived / irreducibly-imported); it never
    inverts the substrate-IS direction.

    on the structural axis and the unlanded determination(s) become the named content of forward gate (d).

## Wave 4 → (downstream) Decision Point

Wave 4 is the terminal wave of investigation-6 (the M_KK adjudication; no investigation-6 wave consumes it). The workshop's two outputs feed forward by the standard investigation→session promotion path (`gate-verdicts.md §"Investigation-Track Canonical Path"` track-local boundary):

- **STRUCTURAL VERDICT (Wrap-Up)** — the over-vs-under-determination reading (OVER-DETERMINED → M_KK derived; UNDER-DETERMINED → §VII.BS rank-1 NNU confirmed; ONE-ROUTE-DOMINATES → named canonical route). If the verdict is a candidate permanent-results-registry landing (e.g. "M_KK is structurally a single irreducible import" hardening §VII.BS, or "the Casimir-volume minimum is the substrate-canonical determination"), it is NOT landed by this exploratory workshop — it is lifted as a carry-forward into a `/rclab-plan` session-mode plan and re-derived under a `session-{N}` gate (with the Stage-1/Stage-2/Stage-3 joint-theorem pathway if it is a cross-axis claim). The workshop names the candidate; the session promotes it.
- **DECISIVE FORWARD GATE (d, Carry-Forward Computations)** — the single compute that resolves the verdict, written as a 4-field spec (what / inputs / gate / effort) per `feedback_fix-in-session-never-defer.md`, mirrored to the WP `## Carry-Forward Computations` block so `/rclab-plan` consumes it for the next session.
- **CROSS-CITE** — at `/rclab-investigate --investigation 6` close AND at the inv-3 close, this workshop and inv-3 W4 cross-reference as the two complementary halves of the M_KK gap (per the DEDUP note above).

## Wave 4 Machinery-Enumeration Pin

None. INV6-W4-1 is a `gate_type: workshop` gate with no producing script — it contributes nothing to `_yaml_gate_validator.py`'s compute/solo machinery-pin aggregate (`plan-investigation.md`: "review/workshop gates contribute nothing here"). The gate's pre-registration is the `workshop:` block in §W4-1 + the artifact-existence `output_artifacts`. There are zero COMPUTE/SOLO gates in this wave.
